_legend_race: Periodic Legend Races -- see app/handlers/legend_race.py. These are the EVENT legend races (ticket item 97), not the permanent daily ones (item 168). Every window in Global's master.mdb schedule has already closed (the last ended 2026-09-09), so leave legend_race_id null for honest real-date behaviour, or set it to a legend_race row id (e.g. 53) to force that race open for testing.
_tp_rp: TP/RP pools -- see app/handlers/stamina.py. Intervals and the career base cost are the measured real values; set career_tp_cost to a number to pin it and ignore campaigns/boosts entirely.
_tp_rp_refill: Paid (carat) pool refills. tp_refill_amount/rp_refill_amount of 0 means 'fill the pool'. The carat prices are OUR choice -- the real ones are client-side and were never captured.
_payment: Carat store -- see app/handlers/payment.py. instant = credit on payment/start and stop before Steam's purchase box; receipt = the real capture flow, credited by payment/finish or payment/dummy; off = catalog only, nothing is ever credited.
_banner_max_age_days: gacha/index listing age limit. null = every banner; 30 = only banners still running at some point in the last 30 days (end_date within 30 days of servertime). Open-ended/upcoming banners and gacha_odds.json "on": true always stay listed.
